leadText:
Impostor Professor Oak (Japanese: にせオーキドはかせ False Doctor Ōkido), sometimes spelled "Imposter Professor Oak", is a villainous character disguised as Professor Oak.

He first appeared on the TCG card and has since made appearances on other cards. He also appears in and the How I Became a Pokémon Card and Pokémon Adventures series.
plainText:
Impostor Professor Oak (Japanese: にせオーキドはかせ False Doctor Ōkido), sometimes spelled "Imposter Professor Oak", is a villainous character disguised as Professor Oak.

He first appeared on the TCG card and has since made appearances on other cards. He also appears in and the How I Became a Pokémon Card and Pokémon Adventures series. 

==Cards featuring Impostor Professor Oak==
 
 
 
 
 

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Trading Card Game series===
In and Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR!, the card is available. The latter game also includes the card.

 

==In animation==
 as Impostor Professor Oak in ]]
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
James disguised himself as in Will the Real Oak Please Stand Up?, along with Jessie disguising herself as DJ Mary. He was successful in imitating Professor Oak for a time, due to help from as well as sheer luck. However, after many tests, including silhouette identification and writing poems, he was discovered.

==== ====
James used the same disguise again in A Faux Oak Finish!, where he took Professor Oak's place in a convention in order to help the Team Rocket trio steal Pokémon from the people attending the convention. However, the real Professor Oak soon showed up and was eventually proven to be the genuine article when he was able to determine the cause behind an audience member's 's odd behavior and fix it by removing a thorn stuck under its foot.
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
Impostor Professor Oak made an appearance in Kalling Kadabra as a disguise used by Sabrina's . It was used to trick into thinking that Kadabra was the real , who had been kidnapped by Team Rocket. After witnessing the fake professor using abilities, Red saw through the ruse and exposed its true identity by draining its energy with Saur's .
 

==Trivia==
The character was intended to appear in Pokémon Gold and Silver Versions as shown by the Spaceworld 1997 demo , but it was later scrapped.
